analysis.title: The Biggest Squeeze In Years: Is This The Bottom
key_insights: NDX is staging one of its most violent upside reversals in years, with futures up about 7% at time of writing and SOX up 14%, after NDX printed its biggest down candle in a long time on Friday.
NDX single-day rallies above 5% have been extremely rare over 15+ years. Prior episodes (April 2025, November 2022, March 2020, December 2018) all occurred at or near major market lows, per Callahan.
Technical resistance remains overhead for NDX: the descending trendline and the 21-day moving average have not been reclaimed.
NVDA is back above the major trendline in place since 2024 but is approaching the $170-190 resistance/congestion zone, with the 21-day MA near $180.
SOX remains below the declining short-term trendline, the 21-day MA, and the longer term trend it broke earlier this month despite the 14% gain.
GS's sector, industry and factor-neutral Beta Index is having its second-best day in more than a decade, behind only Liberation Day, after one of the most painful weeks for hedge funds this year.

GS notes 12-month momentum is outperforming 3-month and 6-month momentum by the largest spread on record. The 12m vs 3m momentum correlation turned negative and the 12m vs 6m correlation fell to a two-year low.

GS Prime Brokerage shows medium-term momentum exposure at the 20th percentile over five years and market sensitivity at the 22nd percentile over one year, so hedge funds have room to rebuild. GS sees room for AI to recover further if AI capex and ROI concerns ease.
